name: T-Box
subtitle: Unofficial TorBox client for iPhone
description: Unofficial TorBox client for iPhone. Add magnets, .torrent files and web links (YouTube, Mega, Mediafire…), share links from any app, manage torrents, web downloads and the queue (AirLock, rename, delete), download in the background to Files or Photos, play MP4 or open in Infuse/VLC, and get notified when something is ready. Works on every TorBox plan, including Free. English and Spanish. No servers, no analytics.
